revisions.reason: The paired spectra-versus-metadata RMSE interval includes zero. The mass-conditioned contrast is a different supported comparison; a null-test result alone does not establish the paired increment.
Use deployed calibration-line-specific blanks. Pooled-lot curvature mixes distinct lines; the Pasadena-dissolves conclusion does not survive the per-line reconstruction.
Later filter-identity and sampling evidence limits historical instrument-comparison claims.
ChemSpec EC mirrors the FTIR EC product, while ChemSpec BC mirrors HIPS/MAC. Neither is an independent thermal EC validation target.

Later work assembled five date-paired Adama quartz/PTFE comparisons, with different physical filters and two comparability flags. This updates availability, not the absence of an independent Addis thermal reference.

The Adama diagnostic shows composition-selected models overpredict its quartz EC, with only five samples, different composition and an unconfirmed analysis-ID mapping. Neither this nor IMPROVE holdouts validates Addis EC accuracy.
The adjusted PMF analysis supports a regional spectral marker but not a charcoal/eucalyptus assignment. Peak position and companion-band evidence remain distinct from fuel-source identification.

On the selected cohort the oracle/composed analysis points to EC_TOR error and target scaling; the full-pool decomposition differs. Keep cohort-specific mechanisms separate from the original descriptive target scores.
